object_context: Fix a smooth projective complex family f:X->S, s0 in S, a flat rational degree-2p class alpha, an irreducible reduced local Hodge-locus branch T through s0, and an already algebraic central signed rational witness z0 for alpha_s0. The active atom tests a proposed genuinely total witness representation after fixed-component bookkeeping routes: replace a signed cycle/Chow class by a rational algebraic K0 class via Chern character, then ask whether this packaging itself supplies new branch-reachable witness deformations. Initial algebraicity, higher Artin effectivity, algebraization, monodromy, singular degeneration and globalization remain outside this first source-interface audit.
structural_coordinates: exact root scope is rational cohomology on smooth projective complex varieties; this deformation lane assumes one already algebraic central witness
for smooth projective complex X, algebraic K0(Vect(X)) tensor Q and CH*(X) tensor Q are related by the rational Chern-character isomorphism; this is a static representation statement
an abstract K0 group-completion class is not by itself a chosen point of a witness moduli functor; dynamic reachability requires a representative such as a perfect complex and its deformation functor
perfect-complex deformation obstructions live in Ext^2 and are functorially mapped by generalized Abel-Jacobi/semiregularity data to the obstruction for the Chern character to remain horizontal/Hodge
kernel vanishing of a detector is weaker than vanishing of the original obstruction unless detector faithfulness on the actual obstruction image is independently proved

denominator clearing and exact codimension-p Chern-character binding must be preserved; a derived representative can have additional Chern-character components and representative-dependent deformation theory
a derived/direct-sum representative can have off-diagonal Ext directions, so moduli-level perfect-complex geometry is not identified with fixed-component Hilbert fibre-product bookkeeping
reduced-branch domination remains the root-aligned local target; full nonreduced scheme-tangent lifting is a separately stronger goal
formal pro-K/Chow lifting results with extra hypotheses are positive source controls but do not automatically transport to arbitrary smooth-projective Hodge branches
equivalent_formulations: static root reformulation: alpha is algebraic iff alpha lies in the degree-2p cohomological Chern-character image of an algebraic K0(X)_Q class
deformation reformulation after choosing E: for every Hodge-preserving branch direction v, the perfect-complex obstruction o_E(v) must vanish (or an exact witness-moduli map must reach v)
detector formulation: Hodge persistence can force only the semiregularity/Abel-Jacobi image of o_E(v) to vanish; a separate kernel-freeness/completeness condition is needed to conclude o_E(v)=0
root-aligned geometric formulation: a coefficient/category-safe total-witness moduli object must dominate T_red, not merely represent the same central Chow class
solved_analogues: codimension-one Picard/line-bundle geometry, where a class has a genuine single-object moduli interpretation and Lefschetz (1,1) supplies algebraicity
rational K0-to-Chow Chern-character isomorphism on regular smooth projective schemes, giving exact static representation equivalence
Pridham's generalized Abel-Jacobi/semiregularity construction for perfect complexes, giving a precise obstruction map and Hodge-filtration obstruction comparison
near_solved_analogues: Bloch-Esnault-Kerz formal deformation of rational algebraic cycle classes under additional Chow-Kunneth/decomposition hypotheses, including abelian-scheme applications
special flag-Hilbert variational Hodge results where an actual source-specific witness incidence dominates the Hodge locus

explicit_disanalogies: K0_Q group completion packages signs algebraically but does not automatically produce a fine moduli point or a deformation map to the base.

A perfect complex representing an integral multiple of a K0_Q class may have deformation directions unrelated to deformations of the originally selected cycle components; this is an escape hatch, not an equivalence.
Vanishing of a semiregularity/Hodge obstruction is a detector statement unless kernel-freeness on actual obstructions is proved.
Bloch-Esnault-Kerz formal deformation is source/hypothesis bound and cannot be generalized by analogy.
A local perfect-complex lift would still require exact rational codimension-p class binding, higher-order compatibility/algebraization as applicable, and local-to-global Hodge-branch coverage.
